name: Ecryu Mel Snowy
original_name: エクリュ・メレ・スノーウィ
source:
Prince of the 'Snow Country Snowy'.
He was chosen to pour power into the 'magic stone'.
A carefree guy who tends to find things bothersome. He's always spacing out and taking naps whenever he has free time.
He's sociable, but he's not good at saying what's on his mind.
His home country is always snowing and frozen, but his dream is to raise flowers that can grow there, he's currently researching how.
